To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) data science is a new field that is intricately intertwined and related to the concepts of big data and data- driven decision making; (ii) the fundamental principles underlying the field have not been identified, although we offer a partial list; and (iii) the fundamental principles of the field will be identified as the field evolves and matures.

data science (1) is not a new field, but a collection of existing techniques and methods; (2) is a field of study that is not well defined and may be difficult to define precisely, but is a natural evolution of statistics, machine learning, and data analysis; (3) has a set of fundamental principles that are not yet well established, and (4) has a relationship to big data that has yet to be clearly defined.
